apps.title: TikTok Pro - Events
apps.description1:
Features of TikTok Pro - Events

Discover Events

Explore a personalized event feed featuring local activities and events based on your interests. Use filters for dates, locations, and event types to find experiences that match your preferences.

Live Event Broadcasting

Stream concerts, performances, and interactive sessions in real time. Organizers can engage online audiences through moderated live chats, guest participation, and instant reactions.

Event Analytics and Marketing

Monitor event performance with insights into views, audience engagement, and ticket sales. Promote upcoming events by scheduling content and reaching relevant audiences to increase visibility and attendance.

apps.title: YouTube Kids
apps.description1:
Features of YouTube Kids

Content Designed for Children

Discover a selection of videos tailored for younger audiences, with content filters designed to reduce exposure to unsuitable material. These features help parents create a more age-appropriate viewing environment for their children.

Parental Controls and Viewing Management

Manage screen time, block specific videos or channels, and report content that may be inappropriate. Parents can also review viewing history and adjust supervision settings to support safer and more controlled online entertainment.

Educational Content and Creative Learning

Encourage curiosity through videos covering science, simple experiments, volcano models, and other educational topics. Choose age-based content preferences to help personalize recommendations and inspire children to learn, explore new ideas, and develop creativity.
apps.description2:
Tips

Create Individual YouTube Kids Profiles

Set up separate profiles for children in your household, with each profile offering its own content preferences and personalized recommendations. Parents can customize viewing settings and manage parental controls after signing in to the YouTube Kids app.

Customize Supervised Viewing Settings

Choose the level of content access that suits your family and decide which videos your children can watch. By linking a Google Account and configuring supervision through the available parent settings, you can manage their viewing experience more effectively.

Set Screen Time Limits

Use the built-in timer to establish daily viewing limits and encourage healthy screen time habits. When the allocated time ends, a friendly notification lets children know their viewing session is over, helping them transition away from the app.

apps.title: BlinkDrama: Short Dramas & TV
apps.description1:
Features of BlinkDrama: Short Dramas & TV

Short Drama Streaming

Enjoy bite-sized drama episodes featuring engaging storylines designed for quick entertainment. Watch individual scenes or complete short episodes whenever you have a few minutes to spare.

Customized Drama Recommendations

Discover shows and stories suited to your viewing preferences and favorite genres. Personalized content suggestions help you find interesting dramas without spending too much time searching.

Convenient Playback Controls

Navigate episodes effortlessly with easy-to-use playback options that let you pause, continue, and switch between episodes. The simple interface provides a smooth and convenient viewing experience.

Watchlist and Viewing History

Bookmark your favorite dramas to watch later and resume episodes from your previous stopping point. Keep track of multiple series and enjoy your preferred stories without losing your progress.

apps.title: FreeDrama: Short Drama & Reels
apps.description1:
Features of FreeDrama: Short Drama & Reels

Wide Collection of Free Entertainment

Explore a diverse range of short dramas, television series, and mini-movies spanning multiple genres. Enjoy streaming without a subscription, with regular content updates that bring fresh stories to the platform.

Rewards for Watching Videos

Collect points or rewards by viewing dramas and completing selected in-app activities. Redeem eligible rewards for special benefits or access to premium content, making entertainment more engaging.

Personalized Show Recommendations

Receive content suggestions based on your viewing preferences and watch history. Customized recommendations and tailored watchlists help you discover new dramas and find stories that suit your interests.

apps.title: FOX One: Live News, Sports, TV
apps.description1:
Features of FOX One: Live News, Sports, TV

Real-Time News Coverage

Keep up with breaking news, major headlines, political developments, and important global events as they unfold. Access timely updates on stories affecting your local community and audiences worldwide.

Live Sports Streaming

Watch sporting events, matches, and games live through available sports channels. Follow your favorite teams and competitions while staying connected to the latest on-field action from different locations.

On-Demand Television and Entertainment

Explore a selection of television shows, programs, and episodes available for on-demand viewing. Browse available content and watch your preferred entertainment at a convenient time without being restricted to scheduled broadcasts.

apps.title: StoryReel: Exclusive Drama
apps.description1:
Features of StoryReel: Exclusive Drama

Exclusive Drama Series

Browse a collection of original drama series and exclusive episodes arranged by genre and release date. Discover compelling stories and regularly updated content designed to keep viewers entertained with fresh episodes.

Tailored Content Recommendations

Find dramas that match your interests through personalized suggestions based on your viewing activity and ratings. Recommendations adapt to your preferences over time, making it easier to explore relevant series through a clean and user-friendly interface.

Offline Downloads and Flexible Playback

Download selected episodes to watch without an internet connection, with available video quality and storage options to manage your downloads. Resume playback from where you stopped and use convenient playback controls for a seamless viewing experience.

apps.title: ReelShort - Stream Drama & TV
apps.description1:
Features of ReelShort - Stream Drama & TV

Extensive Drama and Entertainment Library

Explore a growing collection of series and fresh episodes released regularly, featuring short episodes designed for convenient viewing. Discover a variety of genres, including drama, romance, suspense, thrillers, and emotional stories, so you can enjoy entertainment whenever and wherever you like.

Exclusive Original Short Series

Watch original productions and exclusive bite-sized drama series created for viewers who enjoy engaging stories in a compact format. Browse unique titles and experience captivating episodes without committing to lengthy television programmes.

Multi-Device Viewing Support

Enjoy your favorite dramas across supported devices, including smartphones, tablets, and laptops. For a larger-screen experience, cast compatible content to your television and watch your preferred series more comfortably.

apps.title: zeta: AI Chat, Story, Play
apps.description1:
Features of zeta: AI Chat, Story, Play

Easy-to-Use Story Creation Editor

Create interactive stories by designing scenes, organizing plot sequences, and writing character dialogues through a visual editing interface. Convenient drag-and-drop controls and instant previews help you structure narratives and adjust story flow without requiring coding skills.

Interactive Choices and Story Branches

Build engaging narratives with multiple paths, decision-based outcomes, conditional rules, and customizable variables. Test different reader choices through built-in previews to check story progression and ensure each decision leads to the intended result.

Publish and Share Your Stories

Share completed stories with a creative community, explore content published by other users, and distribute your work through shareable links. Keep unfinished projects private, export supported content, and use reader feedback to improve your storytelling.

apps.title: Netflix
apps.description1:
Features of Netflix

Extensive Movies and TV Shows Collection

Explore a wide range of popular movies, television series, and entertainment from around the world. Netflix regularly updates its library with new releases and fresh episodes, giving viewers more options to discover and enjoy their favorite content.

Personalized Viewing Experience

Receive movie and series recommendations based on your watching habits and preferences. Create up to five individual profiles, allowing each user to maintain personalized suggestions and settings for a more tailored entertainment experience.

New Episode Alerts and Content Updates

Stay informed about upcoming releases, newly available episodes, and recently added titles. Notifications and content updates help you discover fresh entertainment and keep track of shows you want to watch.
apps.description2:
Tips

Resume Watching from Your Continue Watching List

If you leave a movie or series before finishing it, you can easily pick up where you stopped using the Continue Watching section. You can also manage this list by removing titles you no longer plan to watch, keeping your recommendations and viewing list organized.

Download Content for Offline Viewing

Save supported movies and episodes to your mobile device so you can watch them while traveling or in places with limited internet access. Keep in mind that downloads may expire after a certain period, but eligible titles can usually be downloaded again when needed.

apps.title: PineDrama - Short Dramas
apps.description1:
Features of PineDrama - Short Dramas

Personalized Content Recommendations

Discover an endless stream of short dramas, popular clips, and trending videos tailored to your viewing habits. The recommendation system learns from your interests to deliver relevant entertainment.

Easy Video Creation and Editing

Create engaging short videos directly within the app using built-in recording, trimming, filters, visual effects, and music options. Ready-made templates and text stickers make it simple to enhance videos without additional editing software.

Social Engagement and Privacy Settings

Interact with creators through likes, comments, follows, and sharing features while controlling content visibility and download access. Manage basic account privacy settings and report inappropriate content to support a safer community.

apps.title: YouTube TV: Live TV & more
apps.description1:
Features of YouTube TV: Live TV & More

Wide Selection of Live TV Channels

Explore an extensive lineup of live television channels covering sports, breaking news, entertainment, and other popular programs. Browse different categories to find broadcasts that match your interests and enjoy a diverse viewing experience.

Entertainment for Every Interest

Discover a variety of television shows, exclusive programming, and the latest entertainment content in one place. From engaging series to popular programs, YouTube TV offers convenient access to entertainment for different tastes and preferences.

Family-Friendly Viewing Options

Find programs suitable for younger audiences alongside sports and general entertainment. Depending on your subscription and available channels, families can explore children's programming and animated shows while choosing content appropriate for their preferences.

Flexible Streaming and Multiple Accounts

Watch available content on supported smart devices, including televisions, smartphones, and tablets. YouTube TV also supports multiple user profiles and offers Spanish-language programming, helping different household members personalize their viewing experience.
apps.description2:
Tips

Save Programs to Watch Later

Use YouTube TV's Library feature to save your favorite shows, sporting events, and other programs for convenient viewing later. Available recordings can be stored for a limited period, allowing you to catch up on missed episodes and recorded broadcasts at your convenience.

Hide Sports Scores to Avoid Spoilers

Keep the excitement alive when watching recorded sports by hiding game scores before viewing. Where supported, use the available score-hiding controls to avoid learning the results in advance and enjoy replays with more suspense.

Discover Similar Shows and Programs

Find new content based on the programs you already enjoy. Explore similar recommendations within the available browsing options to discover related episodes, shows, and entertainment that match your viewing interests.

Enable Parental Content Restrictions

Customize viewing restrictions to help children access age-appropriate programs. Review the parental control and content filtering settings available for your account or device to limit exposure to unsuitable content and create a more family-friendly viewing experience.

apps.title: Prime Video
apps.description1:
Features of Prime Video

Extensive Movie and TV Show Library

Explore a diverse collection of films, television series, and popular entertainment across multiple genres. From timeless classics to trending releases, Prime Video offers a variety of viewing options to suit different interests and preferences.

Flexible Streaming and Offline Downloads

Download supported movies and episodes to your smartphone or tablet for entertainment without an internet connection. You can also stream compatible content to your television using supported casting features for a more immersive viewing experience.

Personalized Recommendations

Create separate profiles for different household members and receive content suggestions based on their individual viewing habits. Personalized recommendations make it easier to discover movies and series that match each viewer's interests.

Tips

Build Your Watchlist for Later

Save interesting movies and television shows to your Watchlist whenever you don't have time to watch them immediately. Simply open the title and select the option to add it to your list, making it easier to find and enjoy your chosen content later.

Set Parental Controls for Children

Use parental controls to restrict access to content based on age ratings. Set up a Prime Video PIN and configure viewing restrictions through your account settings to help prevent children from accessing unsuitable movies and shows.

Adjust Subtitle Settings

Personalize your viewing experience by changing available subtitle options, including text appearance and display preferences where supported. Configure subtitle settings to improve readability and make dialogue easier to follow while watching your favorite content.

Enable or Disable Autoplay

Choose whether the next episode or recommended video should start automatically after your current selection ends. Adjust the autoplay preference in the available playback settings to match your viewing habits and enjoy greater control over your streaming experience.

apps.title: Disney+
apps.description1:
Features of Disney+

Explore Disney Entertainment at Home

Discover a broad collection of entertainment from Disney and its popular brands, including Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and National Geographic. Stream movies, series, documentaries, and family favorites whenever and wherever supported access is available.

Stream and Download Original Content

Watch exclusive productions, blockbuster movies, and beloved shows from the Disney+ library. Depending on your subscription and region, enjoy an ad-free viewing experience and download eligible titles for offline entertainment.

User-Friendly Interface and Parental Controls

Navigate movies and series through a simple, easy-to-use interface designed for viewers of different ages. Parental control options help families manage children's profiles and choose content that suits their age and viewing needs.

Tips

Use a Stable Internet Connection

For smoother playback, connect to a reliable internet network when streaming or downloading content. If you encounter buffering, freezing, or playback errors, check your connection, restart the app, and update it to the latest available version.

Create Profiles with Age-Appropriate Settings

Set up separate profiles for family members and customize children's viewing restrictions according to their ages. Available profile limits and simultaneous streaming options depend on your subscription plan and region, so check your account settings for the current options.

Browse Categories to Find Content Faster

Save time searching by exploring Disney+ collections and content categories instead of scrolling through the entire library. Browse genres and brand-specific sections to discover your favorite movies, animated features, documentaries, and original series more efficiently.

apps.title: Pluto TV: Watch Free Movies/TV
apps.description1:
Features of Pluto TV: Watch Free Movies/TV

Diverse Movies and Entertainment Library

Explore a varied collection of popular films, timeless classics, and entertaining programs across genres such as comedy, horror, action, and more. Pluto TV offers different viewing options for audiences looking for both familiar favorites and new discoveries.

Spanish-Language Channels and Programs

Discover Spanish-language entertainment featuring movies, dubbed content, reality shows, telenovelas, crime programs, and sports coverage. Available Spanish channels provide viewers with more opportunities to enjoy entertainment in their preferred language.

Free Live TV and On-Demand Streaming

Watch live television channels, movies, and selected sports programming without a traditional subscription. Explore scheduled broadcasts or choose from available on-demand titles whenever you want to enjoy free entertainment, subject to regional availability.

Tips

Start Watching Without a Subscription

Enjoy Pluto TV's free streaming service without creating an account or entering payment details. Creating an account, where supported, may unlock additional conveniences such as saving favorite channels and continuing playback across compatible devices.

Save Movies and Shows to Your Watchlist

Keep track of movies and programs you want to watch later by adding supported titles to your Watchlist. Open a title and look for the available add or plus option to save it, making your preferred entertainment easier to find next time.

apps.title: Peacock TV: Stream TV & Movies
apps.description1:
Features of Peacock TV: Stream TV & Movies

Popular TV Series and Blockbuster Movies

Explore complete seasons of well-known television series, classic favorites, and current-season releases. Movie lovers can also discover a broad selection of films from major studios, including Universal and DreamWorks Animation, alongside other entertainment options.

Entertainment, Sports, and News in One Place

Enjoy more than movies and television shows with access to available sports coverage, news broadcasts, and other engaging programs. Peacock Channels offer scheduled entertainment throughout the day, making it easy to find content that suits different interests.

Personalized Profiles and Family Content

Create individual profiles for household members and receive recommendations tailored to their viewing preferences. Families can also explore children's programming and animated shows, with available profile settings helping organize entertainment for different age groups.

Premium Streaming Benefits

Eligible Premium subscriptions provide access to additional entertainment, selected live events, and expanded sports coverage. Depending on the plan, subscribers may also enjoy fewer advertisements or an ad-free experience for supported content.
apps.description2:
Tips

Rewind Live Events to Catch Missed Moments

If you join a live broadcast late, use the rewind feature to revisit moments you missed. The available rewind duration may vary by device and platform, helping you catch up on important scenes without waiting for a replay.

Personalize Subtitle Appearance

Improve readability by adjusting subtitle settings to suit your preferences. Where supported, customize options such as text size, color, font, and shadow through the app's subtitle or accessibility settings for a more comfortable viewing experience.

apps.title: Paramount+
apps.description1:
Features of Paramount+

Explore Popular Shows and Exclusive Originals

Stream a wide selection of popular TV series whenever and wherever you want with Paramount+. Enjoy well-known shows like Survivor and NCIS, along with exclusive original content such as iCarly and Evil Season 2, available to subscribers.

Stay Updated with Live Sports and News

Keep up with the latest sports headlines, event coverage, and live broadcasts on Paramount+. Follow your favorite sporting events in real time and enjoy an engaging viewing experience without missing important moments.

Unlock More Benefits with a Subscription

Upgrade to a premium subscription to access additional features, including local live TV channels, major live events, and supported downloads for offline viewing. Enjoy greater flexibility in how and when you watch your favorite content.
apps.description2:
Tips

Check Whether You Qualify for a Free Subscription

Some eligible T-Mobile customers may receive Paramount+ at no additional cost through a qualifying wireless plan or promotion. Check the current offer on T-Mobile's official website and follow the activation instructions if your plan is eligible. Availability and offer terms may change, and eligibility restrictions apply.

Save Favorites to MY LIST

Found a show or movie you want to watch later? Add it to MY LIST to keep your favorite content organized in one place. You can return to your saved titles whenever you're ready to watch.

Download Content for Offline Viewing

Make entertainment more convenient by downloading supported movies and shows to a compatible mobile device. Offline viewing is useful when you're traveling or have limited internet access. Downloads require an eligible subscription plan, and availability may depend on the title and device.

apps.title: Roku Remote (Official)
apps.description1:
Features of Roku Remote (Official)

Control Your Roku Device with Ease

Turn your smartphone into a convenient remote for your Roku device without needing a separate physical remote. Use the mobile keyboard to enter search terms, passwords, and other text more quickly and easily.

Search with Voice and Share Media

Find your favorite entertainment using voice commands or the on-screen keyboard. You can also cast supported photos and videos from your phone to your TV, making it easier to enjoy personal media on a larger screen.

Enjoy More Convenient Entertainment

Listen privately through compatible headphones using the app's private listening feature. Explore free movies and shows through The Roku Channel where available, and add channels to your Roku device to personalize your entertainment experience.
apps.description2:
Tips

Rewind Quickly with Instant Replay

Missed a line of dialogue or an important moment? Press the Instant Replay button on your Roku remote to jump back a few seconds. The replay interval can vary depending on the device, app, or streaming channel, so the amount of time rewound may differ.

Organize Channels on Your Home Screen

Keep your favorite channels easy to find by arranging their positions on the Roku home screen. Highlight the channel you want to move, open the options menu, select Move Channel, and use the directional buttons to place it where you prefer.

Open Content Faster with Voice Commands

Save time navigating menus by using voice control on a compatible Roku remote or the Roku mobile app. Press and hold the microphone button, speak your request, and release it when finished. Depending on your device and supported features, you can ask Roku to launch a channel, play a title, or search for content.
